title: Customer Service Advisor
description:
Are you a great listener who can stay calm under pressure and help people get the support they need?
We're looking for a Customer Service Advisor or a Call Handler to join a busy out-of-hours helpdesk team in Blackburn. With the busy season approaching, the team is expanding to support an increase in calls from tenants reporting maintenance and repairs requests.
Paying 13.45 per hour, this is a temporary position for 12 weeks working in the evenings during the week and weekends, with the opportunity to go permanent. You'll receive training on the company's established processes and systems, so you'll understand how to assess requests, record information accurately and ensure each issue reaches the right team.
If you have at least 1 year of call centre or customer service experience and enjoy helping people find solutions, this could be a great opportunity for you!
What will you be doing as a Customer Service Advisor / Call Handler?
- Answering a high volume of calls from tenants reporting maintenance and repairs requests
- Listening carefully to understand the problem and asking the right questions to establish the root cause
- Following a structured questionnaire to gather all the necessary information about each issue
- Assessing and triaging requests as emergency, urgent or non-emergency
- Recording information accurately using ticketing systems, drop-down menus and set processes
- Passing completed requests to the appropriate team, who will arrange the necessary repairs or fixes
- Providing reassurance and clear information to tenants, including those who may be vulnerable or distressed
- Recognising when an issue needs further attention and escalating it in line with the relevant procedures

What's in it for you?
- 13.45 per hour
- Opportunity to secure a longer-term position after the initial 12 weeks.
- Established training programme
- 2 paid 10-minute breaks during your shift.
- Unpaid 30-minute lunch break.
- Immediate start
- Valuable experience - develop your call handling, problem-solving and customer service skills in a fast-paced environment

Why would you join this company?
You'll be joining an established team providing an important out-of-hours service, helping tenants report property issues and ensuring their concerns are recorded, prioritised and passed to the right people for action.
Accuracy is key, as the information you gather helps the repairs team understand the problem and arrange the appropriate fix. You'll be supported by an established training process, giving you the knowledge and guidance needed to learn the systems and carry out the role effectively.
This is a great opportunity for someone who enjoys helping people, working as part of a team and making a practical difference to the customer experience.
What we're looking for
What's essential:
- At least 1 year's call centre customer service experience.
- Strong listening skills and the ability to ask relevant questions to understand a customer's issue.
- An empathetic approach and good emotional intelligence, particularly when speaking to vulnerable or distressed customers.
- Clear communication skills and a professional telephone manner.
- Excellent attention to detail, ensuring information is recorded accurately and all required questions are answered.
- The ability to follow set procedures and categorise requests correctly.
- The ability to manage a high volume of calls, moving efficiently from one conversation to the next while maintaining good customer service.

What's helpful but not essential:
- Experience in property maintenance, housing, repairs or facilities management.
- Experience using ticketing systems, CRM databases or structured call-handling questionnaires.
- Experience assessing and prioritising customer requests or incidents.

The Essentials
Salary: 13.45 per hour
Hours: Weekday evenings, 5:00 pm-10:00 pm, and weekend shifts, 8:00 am-5:00 pm. Shifts will depend on the rota and service requirements.
Breaks: Two paid 10-minute breaks and one unpaid 30-minute lunch break per shift.
Location: Blackburn
Job type: Temporary for 12 weeks, with the opportunity to go permanent.
Start date: Immediate

title: Care Navigator (Medical Receptionist)
description: Are you a great listener who loves helping people ? Do you want a job where every day makes a real difference to your local community ? We're looking for a Care Navigator/Medical Receptionist to join our friendly team at Lambeth Street Surgery, Blackburn for 30 hours a week. Care Navigators are at the heart of modern general practice. You'll often be the first person our patients speak to, whether they walk in, phone or contact us online. By listening carefully and asking the right questions, you'll help them get to the right person or service first time, whether that's a GP, nurse, pharmacist, paramedic or a service in the community. Lambeth Street serves a diverse and close-knit community, and no two days are the same. You'll also be part of our Connect Hub at Shadsworth Surgery, where we're developing a new model of care navigation with daily support from our GPs and ACPs. It's an exciting time to join us. You don't need to have worked in a GP practice before. If you're caring, calm, under pressure and enjoy working as part of a team, we'll give you the training and support to grow in the role. If you want a job with purpose, we'd love to hear from you. As a Care Navigator, your day will be varied. You will: Welcome patients at the front desk, answer calls and respond to online requests through Patchs Listen to what each patients needs and guide them to the right clinician or service, using our care navigation protocols Spot urgent requests and pass them quickly to the clinical team Book appointments and deal with prescription, test results and general queries Help patients use online services such as the NHS App, and support those who prefer not to Take your turn on the rota at our Connect Hub at Shadsworth Surgery, handling telephone and online contacts with support from our GPs and ACPs Share the day-to-day running of the Lambeth Street site with the team, including admin supporting the baby clinic and routine health and safety checks Keep patients records accurate and confidential on Emis Web Full training is given, including care navigation training, so you'll feel confident from the start. Please see the attached job description and person specification for full details. This role is the focal point of high-quality communication between patients, clinicians and outside organisations, helping ensure services are delivered safely, efficiently and compassionately. This is a part-time post of 30 hours per week. The post holder will be primarily at Lambeth Street Surgery and like all members of the care navigator team, will be rotate to the Connect Hub at Shadsworth Surgery as part of the Practice's new model of care navigation and triage. The Connect Hub deals predominantly with remote contacts (telephone and online). Flexibility is key, as the post may occasionally require support outside of regular hours to provide cover.
